ModMetaData.name: Set my Defaults – Bills, Shelves, Zones, Policies, Colonists
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
Set something up once, save it as a default, and it is applied from then on: bills on new workbenches, filters on new shelves and stockpiles, plants on new growing zones and hydroponics, schedule, work and policies on new colonists, your policies and colony settings in new games. Optional: more than 15 bills per workbench.
All presets live in one library outside your saves, so they follow you into every colony. The Defaults button opens it in game; named profiles and share strings come with it. A new colony starts with a welcome card. Presets of older versions are imported once. Colonists, zones and shelves you already have are never changed. Each area can be switched off in the settings.
Removing the mod: nothing to prepare, nothing of it is in your save. What it applied stays as normal RimWorld settings; with JB Framework still installed the save loads without an error.
Needs Harmony and JB Framework. When JB Framework is missing, the game offers to install it. Tested with Nice Bill Tab and Better Workbench Management; Project RimFactory, Blueprints Forked and Free Will integrations carried over untested. No Max Bills Redux owns the bill limit while it works, otherwise this mod lifts it. Multiplayer: not supported, untested.
Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested. 1.7 is the focus; 1.6 gets the same version, built for 1.6 but never run there.
Made with the help of Claude Code. Code: https://github.com/jb-rimworld/set-my-defaults (MIT).
